My best prediction is that a sympathetic human would change Mohammed’s SC to DEP, and would probably change Ryan’s SC to DEP as well, adding a note about his message and his call to Gary. The likely motivation would be to avoid an automatic dismissal over a genuine family emergency, especially since Ryan did notify his team leader.

That would be a compassionate workaround, not a code supported by the stated rules: Ryan’s sister lives separately and is not among the listed DEP relatives, and he says he was not ill. A more compliance-focused employee might leave Ryan as UA and urgently escalate, but there is no time for a reply before payroll. Leanne would remain SC; Karen and Paul would remain UA.
